doc.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013

title: Cannonball's equipment: mouthpiece, reeds and horns
summary: Johnstone uses Cannonball's mouthpiece model and reed strength; they discuss his switch to Selmer horns.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: And he plays that note and, I don’t know, maybe it’s just me but — © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -21-
Well I have the exact model mouthpiece that he had, a New York Meyer hard rubber 5, which I use on alto. I use the same strength reeds that he used. And I have a King Super 20 alto.
Do you know when he switched horns I noticed it on his records. He started playing Selmers at some point.
Yeah. Maybe he was getting free instruments or something.
Could be. He changed mouthpieces a couple of times too.
